async def act(page):
    # The 'Invite members' dialog is already open as per the accessibility tree
    # Add each member: patou, egpast, westurner, jontutcher
    members = ['patou', 'egpast', 'westurner', 'jontutcher']
    for member in members:
        # Locate the textbox in the listbox within the dialog
        textbox = page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Invite members').get_by_role('listbox').get_by_role('textbox')
        await textbox.fill(member)
        # Press Enter to add the member (assuming it triggers addition)
        await textbox.press('Enter')
        await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for UI to update
        # Set the role to 'Guest' (default selected) or use another if needed
        # The combobox requires .select_option() as per the tree note
        combobox = page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Invite members').get_by_role('combobox', name='Select a role')
        await combobox.select_option('Guest')  # Use default role
        # If there's an 'Add' or 'Invite' button, click it, but not shown in tree
        # After adding, the dialog might update; continue to next member
    # After adding all members, close the dialog if necessary
    close_button = page.get_by_role('dialog', name='Invite members').get_by_role('button', name='Close')
    await close_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # No further actions needed; members have been added
    pass
